derived.line_range_order_note: mpcollision.c line loops early-out (goto l_break) assuming floor/rwall ranges are ordered by non-increasing coll_pos_next and ceil/lwall ranges by non-decreasing coll_pos_prev; keep the stored line order in the port.

yakumono.motion: no collision lines, not animated (render-only DObj)

code.summary: Balance-scale platforms (dGRInishieScaleLineGroups = {1 (left, mapobj ScaleL), 2 (right, mapobj ScaleR)}). Status On at init; every tick mpCollisionSetYakumonoPosID(id, platform_dobj.translate) where platform x/y start at the ScaleL/ScaleR map object position. left.y = base_y + splat_alt, right.y = base_y - splat_alt. Pressure per side = sum over grounded fighters on that yakumono of w = (1 - attr->weight) + 1.4, x8 on the landing tick (players_tt). splat_accelerate += (r - l); *0.93 if both sides loaded, else decays by 0.9 toward 0; splat_alt += splat_accelerate; with no load splat_alt returns to 0 by 8/tick. |splat_alt| > 1100 -> both fall (accel +3/tick, max 70) until below map_bound_bottom - 1000, then Off for 180 ticks, then ScaleRetract anim + splat_alt returns toward 0 by 10/tick, then On again.
code.position_formula: left: (ScaleL.x, ScaleL.y + splat_alt); right: (ScaleR.x, ScaleR.y - splat_alt)
